tasks.spec:
You are implementing a bounded first-party Google Gemini CLI OAuth worker lane for Ringer on Linux. Your current working directory is a disposable Ringer task directory. Do not modify any repository, home-directory file, configuration, credential, external system, or source file. Do not call MCP/Apps, load skills, use the network, install anything, commit, or push. You may read only these local source references: /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/engines/claude-oauth.sh, /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/tests/test_oauth_wrappers.py, and the installed Gemini CLI documentation under /home/ankit114/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@google/gemini-cli/bundle/docs. Own exactly four deliverables in the current directory: ./gemini-oauth.sh, ./gemini-oauth-settings.json, ./gemini-engine.toml, and ./test_gemini_oauth_wrapper.py.

Requirements: (1) gemini-oauth.sh must be Bash with strict mode, use the normal `gemini` executable from PATH, and fail closed with exit 64 without printing credential or settings contents. Read only ~/.gemini/settings.json to require security.auth.selectedType exactly `oauth-personal`, and require metadata presence of ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json or ~/.gemini/google_accounts.json without reading or printing credential contents. (2) Unset inherited API-key, Vertex/ADC, custom-base-url, alternate-config-root, and test-override environment variables, including GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION, GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL, GEMINI_CLI_HOME, GEMINI_SYSTEM_MD, and inherited GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH. Then force GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH to the sibling gemini-oauth-settings.json using the wrapper's resolved directory. (3) Accept exactly one -m/--model selector, normalize only `google/<bare-gemini-model>` to its bare form, and reject OpenRouter or other provider prefixes. Reject duplicate/empty model selectors, `--`, --yolo/-y, approval mode yolo/default, alternate settings/config/home/base-url/provider/backend/profile routes, extensions, MCP allowlists, include-directories, worktree/resume/session flags, and other arguments that could widen scope or change auth. Allow the Ringer-required prompt, model, output-format json/stream-json, skip-trust, and approval-mode auto_edit or plan. Preserve the exact prompt text without evaluating it in shell. (4) gemini-oauth-settings.json must enforce oauth-personal, secure mode, environment-variable redaction, disable extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, subagents, telemetry, and neutralize ambient GEMINI.md discovery by setting context.fileName to `.ringer-no-context.md`. (5) gemini-engine.toml must define [engines.gemini], point bin at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/engines/gemini-oauth.sh, set model_default to gemini-3.5-flash, set auth_routing_trusted=true, and pass -m {model}, --approval-mode auto_edit, --output-format json, --skip-trust, {engine_args}, and -p {spec}; no full-access args. (6) test_gemini_oauth_wrapper.py must independently fake the gemini executable and prove valid OAuth routing, environment scrubbing, Google selector normalization, fixed system-settings path, wrong-auth refusal, credential-cache-metadata refusal, and unsafe-argument refusal without exposing secret sentinels. Keep tests standard-library only. Current preserved build failed because it used `admin.strictMode` instead of the documented `admin.secureModeEnabled`, and used `args` instead of Ringer's required `args_template`. Correct those and any further issues. Finish only after running `bash -n gemini-oauth.sh`, `python3 test_gemini_oauth_wrapper.py`, and the exact independent gate `python3 /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/auditions/gemini-cli-oauth/checks/validate_lane_build.py` successfully from the task directory.
